dataset_metadata.name: HAWK-I Semantic Search Benchmark Dataset
dataset_metadata.author: Kashyap Nasit (24CS109)
dataset_metadata.description: Annotated query-to-event benchmark dataset for evaluating semantic search precision in CCTV surveillance intelligence.

corpus_events.description: White sedan car detected entering through CAM-01 Main Entrance Gate. License plate KA-01-AB-1234 recognized with 98.5% confidence.
Perimeter breach detected at CAM-06 Perimeter Fence South. Individual climbing outer barrier during restricted curfew hours.
Extended loitering alert at CAM-04 Parking Lot North. Person stationary near parked vehicles for 450 seconds exceeding dwell threshold.
Authorized employee access recognized at CAM-02 Lobby East entrance turnstile matching employee directory #405.
Unattended object detected at CAM-05 Loading Dock B. Black backpack left unattended in high-traffic freight corridor for over 10 minutes.
Large crowd formation detected at CAM-08 Cafeteria Overlook with 35 individuals congregating rapidly near fire exit corridor.
Unauthorized access breach at CAM-03 Server Room A. Unidentified individual detected inside restricted server rack enclosure without RFID badge scan.
Vehicle speed violation at CAM-01 Main Entrance. Red sedan clocked traveling 54.2 km/h in designated 25.0 km/h entrance security zone.
Commercial delivery truck detected maneuvering at 18.0 km/h across CAM-04 Parking Lot North delivery apron.
Object misplacement anomaly at CAM-03 Server Room A. Metal toolbox left open in front of emergency power distribution panel.
Suspicious person lingering near CAM-06 Perimeter Fence South boundary line for 180 seconds during night watch.
Registered staff vehicle license plate MH-02-CD-5678 verified at CAM-01 Main Entrance barrier gate.
Missing object anomaly at CAM-05 Loading Dock B. Wooden cargo pallet removed from designated staging bay 3 without dispatch log.
Vehicle speed violation at CAM-04 Parking Lot North. Sports coupe detected accelerating at 62.1 km/h exceeding 20 km/h parking speed limit.
Dwell time anomaly at CAM-03 Server Room A. Individual remained stationary inside high-security optical vault for 95 seconds.

evaluation_queries.rationale: Event 8 is a red car speeding at entrance gate (54.2 km/h); Event 1 is a car entering the entrance gate.
Event 2 is perimeter fence climbing breach; Event 11 is suspicious person near perimeter fence.
Event 5 is unattended black backpack left in loading dock.
Event 7 is unauthorized server room intrusion; Event 15 is loitering inside server room vault.
Events 1 and 12 are ANPR plate recognition events at entrance.
Event 3 is extended loitering in North Parking lot.

evaluation_queries.rationale: Event 14 is a speeding car in parking lot (62.1 km/h); Event 9 is a truck in parking lot.
Event 13 is missing wooden cargo pallet from loading dock staging bay.
